steps.label: Writes Fail
steps.sub: claims-processing throws write errors immediately after

steps.label: Azure Side?
steps.sub: confirm the group actually promoted the secondary first

eyebrow: Step 1 -- did Azure actually fail over
code:
az sql failover-group show \
  --name thornridge-sql-failover-group \
  --server thornridge-sql-server-secondary \
  --query "{role:replicationRole}"

# "replicationRole": "Primary"
caption: thornridge-sql-server-secondary is now Primary -- the DR mechanism worked.

eyebrow: Step 2 -- is the database itself healthy
code:
-- Connect directly to the new primary
INSERT INTO dbo.ClaimsAuditLog (claim_id, event_type, event_timestamp)
VALUES (999999, 'FAILOVER_DRILL_WRITE_TEST', SYSUTCDATETIME());

-- Succeeds immediately
caption: A direct write against the new primary succeeds -- not a database problem.

subtitle: The database layer is fine. The application layer isn't.
